cc:Work.dc:title: f06_b570
cc:Work.dc:description: Three rows each retain 24 measured root ratios and an open-diamond equal-root summary on one continuous log axis. Grouped/scalar target-only execution is 0.783 with 95% interval 0.770 to 0.797; grouped/scalar speculation is 0.872 with interval 0.870 to 0.874. Grouped speculation versus grouped target-only is 2.512 with interval 2.486 to 2.539, to the right of the equal-time line at one and therefore slower. The 72 root marks reuse the same 24 roots across three contrasts. Numeric limits retain the narrow grouping intervals without changing their graphical extent.
